device_name: CoRoent Small Interlock PEEK ACDF Spacer
description: The CoRoent Small Interlock PEEK ACDF spacer is a no-profile intervertebral implant designed for reduced surgical exposure, minimal number of implants, and simplified implantation procedure. The circumferential locking ledge with visible triangle laser marks within the screw hole provide both tactile and visual confirmation of the locking mechanism.
